options.carrier: an overhead field of experience artifacts that clusters into patterns pointing toward a future destination
options.layout_family: top-down constellation table with circular clusters radial groupings and object-scale transformations

milestones.visual_event: experience tokens scatter around a central future destination
irrelevant tokens drift away while a clear cluster remains

a lateral cluster crosses contexts through transferable capability nodes
RAMS turns four orbiting nodes into one structured evidence object
the resolved cluster locks onto a clear future bearing

rejected.reason: The print-shop metaphor supports RAMS well but is less immediate for the opening question and the two role examples.
The constellation has strong motion potential but risks recalling the rejected signal-map logic and making evidence relationships feel abstract.

selection.rationale: Future Gallery is the clearest teaching lens because the narration names curation directly, while changing rooms let each idea own a different full-frame composition without persistent side furniture.
